h4_modern_gap_mean_ms.desc: H4 average athlete-adjusted sex gap (women minus men) over championships (sex main effect, sum-coded), POST-HOC: championships from 2015 on (athlete-identified; addendum 5)

h4_modern_gap_range_ms.desc: H4 spread (max - min) of the per-championship sex gap, POST-HOC: championships from 2015 on (athlete-identified; addendum 5)

h4_modern_gap_tau_ms.desc: H4 between-championship SD of the sex gap net of sampling error (DerSimonian-Laird), POST-HOC: championships from 2015 on (athlete-identified; addendum 5)

h4_modern_gap_pi_ms.desc: H4 95% prediction interval (in ci95) of a championship's sex gap: average +/- 1.96 tau, POST-HOC: championships from 2015 on (athlete-identified; addendum 5)

h4_modern_n_negative.desc: H4 championships whose point estimate has women faster than men, POST-HOC: championships from 2015 on (athlete-identified; addendum 5)

h4_verdict.desc: pre-registered H4 verdict (addendum 3), all events: LRT p < 0.05 and the prediction interval includes 0 -> championship-dependent (sign not stable)

h5_men_incl2022_p_lt100.desc: H5 Fiore et al. 2025 model (men_incl2022; published parameters): marginal P(RT<0.100) over venue and heat (quadrature)

h5_men_incl2022_barrier_1e3_ms.desc: H5 Fiore et al. model (men_incl2022): 1e-3 barrier of the marginal distribution

h5_men_incl2022_median_venue_barrier_1e3.desc: H5 Fiore et al. model (men_incl2022): 1e-3 barrier at the median venue (venue effect 0; heat integrated)

h5_men_incl2022_marginal_minus_median_ms.desc: H5 (men_incl2022): marginal minus median-venue 1e-3 barrier (what averaging over venues does)

h5_men_incl2022_implied_beta0.desc: H5 POST-HOC diagnostic (addendum 5): intercept beta0 that reproduces the published P(RT<0.100) of set men_incl2022 with its other printed parameters

h5_men_incl2022_venue_range95_ms.desc: H5 (men_incl2022): 1e-3 barrier at the 97.5th minus the 2.5th percentile venue of N(0, tau_v^2) - how far venue moves the barrier inside Fiore et al.'s own model

h5_men_excl2022_p_lt100.desc: H5 Fiore et al. 2025 model (men_excl2022; published parameters): marginal P(RT<0.100) over venue and heat (quadrature)

h5_men_excl2022_barrier_1e3_ms.desc: H5 Fiore et al. model (men_excl2022): 1e-3 barrier of the marginal distribution

h5_men_excl2022_median_venue_barrier_1e3.desc: H5 Fiore et al. model (men_excl2022): 1e-3 barrier at the median venue (venue effect 0; heat integrated)

h5_men_excl2022_marginal_minus_median_ms.desc: H5 (men_excl2022): marginal minus median-venue 1e-3 barrier (what averaging over venues does)

h5_men_excl2022_implied_beta0.desc: H5 POST-HOC diagnostic (addendum 5): intercept beta0 that reproduces the published P(RT<0.100) of set men_excl2022 with its other printed parameters

h5_men_excl2022_venue_range95_ms.desc: H5 (men_excl2022): 1e-3 barrier at the 97.5th minus the 2.5th percentile venue of N(0, tau_v^2) - how far venue moves the barrier inside Fiore et al.'s own model

h5_women_p_lt100.desc: H5 Fiore et al. 2025 model (women; published parameters): marginal P(RT<0.100) over venue and heat (quadrature)

h5_women_barrier_1e3_ms.desc: H5 Fiore et al. model (women): 1e-3 barrier of the marginal distribution

h5_women_median_venue_barrier_1e3_ms.desc: H5 Fiore et al. model (women): 1e-3 barrier at the median venue (venue effect 0; heat integrated)

h5_women_marginal_minus_median_ms.desc: H5 (women): marginal minus median-venue 1e-3 barrier (what averaging over venues does)

h5_women_implied_beta0.desc: H5 POST-HOC diagnostic (addendum 5): intercept beta0 that reproduces the published P(RT<0.100) of set women with its other printed parameters

h5_women_venue_range95_ms.desc: H5 (women): 1e-3 barrier at the 97.5th minus the 2.5th percentile venue of N(0, tau_v^2) - how far venue moves the barrier inside Fiore et al.'s own model

h5_years_barrier_range_ms.desc: H5 secondary: range of the 1e-3 barrier across the 13 WCH venues (1999-2023) using each venue's own effect read from Fiore et al.'s vector figure (removed from the published paper), men incl. 2022

h5_pdf_excl2022_intercept_shift.desc: H5 POST-HOC diagnostic (addendum 5): mean venue effect over the 12 shared years in the figure's top panel (model incl. 2022) minus the bottom panel (model excl. 2022) - the intercept change that removing 2022 implies

h5_year2022_barrier_1e3_ms.desc: H5 secondary: 1e-3 barrier at the 2022 venue (its effect read from the figure), men incl. 2022

h5_verdict_reproduced.desc: pre-registered H5 reproduction verdict (addendum 3): every published marginal P(RT<0.100) within 5% and every published barrier within 1 ms

h5_verdict_venue.value: VENUE MATERIAL WITHIN FIORE ET AL.'S MODEL
h5_verdict_venue.desc: pre-registered H5 venue verdict: 1e-3 barrier range between the 2.5th and 97.5th percentile venues (men incl. 2022) >= 10 ms

o2_diff_M.desc: O2: pooled minus championship-centred r (paired bootstrap), sex=M

o2_r_pooled_W.desc: O2 (optional): Pearson r of RT and 100 m time, pooled over championships, sex=W (race-cluster bootstrap within championship)

o2_r_champ_W.desc: O2 (optional): Pearson r of RT and 100 m time, after centring RT and time within championship, sex=W (race-cluster bootstrap within championship)

o2_r_race_W.desc: O2 (optional): Pearson r of RT and 100 m time, within race (both centred within race), sex=W (race-cluster bootstrap within championship)

o2_diff_W.desc: O2: pooled minus championship-centred r (paired bootstrap), sex=W
